tools.name: lookup_fault_code
tools.description: Look up one fault/error/status code across all KasaFox registry brands and return the normalised meaning, causes, checks, fix steps, parts, safety flags, and citations. Cite the source and hard-stop on safety-critical faults (requires_qualified_installer).

tools.name: search_codes
tools.description: Search the registry by code, brand, or title/meaning text and return matching rows with their canonical URLs.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List the brands in the registry with code counts and the vertical surface that owns each brand.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_fault_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
